reviews.title: Yet another app that’s going Subscription Only
reviews.text: Not only can I not use the iPhone Storage portion of my iPhone’s settings app with this app installed (it crashes settings immediately), now this app is going subscription only over the next few months. Some features as of 19 MAY 2026 have already been moved to pro exclusive, with more to move as time goes on. Really disappointing, as I’m already using my phone’s processing power and hardware to do these scans, it’s like tipping a restaurant for you self-serving your own food… and I know I know, you will say “if you cannot afford to subscribe you shouldn’t be using this app”… I would get it if this was a cloud based computing app, not one that runs locally or would need a MacBook (in some cases) to use its processing power. Thanks for the 14GB of storage and the use of my settings app back though, uninstalled.

reviews.title: Genuinely devastated

Reading other reviews it seems like some people can still access basic things, but I cannot even use the basic scan mode, it just pops up the subscription window. I used to tell my students to download this app, and have countless examples of amazing art projects made using just phones and blender. This subscription is simply too high of a barrier. Yet another thing made inaccessible to them because of money. I mourn that loss.

reviews.title: Mediocre 3D Scans, Now With Subscription
reviews.text:
I’d used this app a few years ago, when it was free and used on-device compute. It was never super great on scan quality, but at least it generally worked.

I opened up this app today and suddenly it wants a subscription, and even exporting my raw data is locked behind a paywall. The update notes also only mention “bug fixes.”

I don’t mind paying for an app, if it at least tries to be good, but this app has never been close to state-of-the-art, and it’s continued to fall behind. I didn’t mind that while it was free, but now there’s no reason not to use a different paid app that’s kept up with the times.

reviews.title: What happened?
reviews.text:
This was one of the first apps that I got when I first got my iPhone 12 Pro for 3D scanning things and stuck with it ever since because I was able to export the entire scan data file(Via the all data option) to another device with the same app.

When I updated it to fix the issues I was having. I was sad to see that it is now paywalled, even when I did registered for the subscription service I still wasn’t able to export the files that I wanted to send. I’ll be looking for alternatives for this app since the export feature is still broken for me even after the update.

The only way that I would ever return to using this app is if there was a one time purchase and it doesn’t require an internet connection if I’m in a place or area where cell service is poor or nonexistent.

reviews.title: Free => Subscription-only. Greedy rug-pullers.
reviews.text: I see how it is, now. What was once free is now subscription-only. This is a basic ARKit mesher which is advertised as an iOS app feature available to developers, encapsulated in this app. You can test it out using AR Foundation samples for Unity. I’ve exported my own apps using this packaged feature.  Yet these guys decided to suddenly hide it behind a paywall. I used this since 2022. It has since seen no improvements since that time, except now the basic functionality is hidden behind a trial period and subscription fee. F off with that nonsense. I’m too fatigued by this terrible transition “you will own nothing”. Provide a fixed price option or delete this app from the store. You’ve angered your users and clearly you do not care, based on your generic “thank you for feedback! Please email us!” response to everything. Zero explanation. We are owed that if you want our *trust* much less our money.

reviews.title: It should be a crime charging old users that always was free license.
reviews.text: In 2020 I was one of the first people in the world who had the iPhone 12 Pro in my hands. I bought it within the first seconds after Apple’s website opened and received it in the first delivery batch. On the first day I downloaded this app, and since the iPhone 12 Pro was the first model with a LiDAR scanner, I was probably one of the first users. I helped spread this software to friends and strangers everywhere. Now, after six years of using this app, they decided to start charging an absurd price. This should be a crime. I know it is not, but I wish it were. Early users, especially the original ones, should at least receive a lifetime license, whether free or paid. It feels like they used us as guinea pigs, and now after all the troubleshooting, we are the target. I feel betrayed, and I will do my best to let all my friends know about this and encourage them to remove the app.

reviews.title: No one-time purchase??

Especially when some of the previous features are now locked behind a subscription now. It’s very disappointing.

reviews.title: Bait and switch
reviews.text:
I have used 3D Scanner App for years. The functionality is good, on par with other apps that also use Apple's built-in photogrammetry tools. Today I downloaded an updated that was listed as "Bug fixing and stability improvements". When I opened the app, it demanded a subscription of $30/year. No more free functionality, and no warning. No way to downgrade.

Charging for good software is entirely reasonable. Baiting users with "Bug fixing" and switching on them with an unexpected pricing model change is downright unethical.

Shame—SHAME on this developer.
